mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.issuing_entity: Business Registration Office under the Department of Planning and Investment of the home country
mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.authentication_path: Hague Apostille (if the home country is a Hague Convention member, Vietnam is a member) OR Consular Legalization (if the home country is not a Hague member, via Vietnamese Embassy/Consulate)

mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.issuing_entity: A notary public or equivalent competent authority in the home jurisdiction

mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.issuing_entity: Passport office / competent authority of the individual's home country

mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.document_name: English translation of the parent company's audited financial statements (for economic substance review if requested)
mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.issuing_entity: Independent auditor in the home jurisdiction
mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.authentication_path: Hague Apostille OR Consular Legalization (or notarized translator certification if accepted)

ubo_and_aml_profiling.pep_and_sanctions_screening_protocols: Mandatory PEP screening as per Article 7 of Law on Anti-Money Laundering and Article 17 of Decree 19/2023/ND-CP; mandatory screening against OFAC SDN List, UN Security Council Consolidated List, EU Consolidated Financial Sanctions List, Vietnamese domestic terrorist financing list issued by SBV, and the Government's Decision on sanctions, including at least 3-year backward review and ongoing monitoring; enhanced due diligence for PEPs, their family members, and close associates; risk tiering based on customer country, occupation, and business sector.

statutory_name_clearance_protocol.language_and_transliteration_doctrine: Vietnamese legal name of the company must be in Vietnamese script; a Latin transliteration (or translated Vietnamese name) is mandatory. The name must consist of the business type indicator ('Công ty TNHH' or 'Công ty Trách nhiệm hữu hạn') followed by a proper name. Foreign-language names may be provided but must be transliterated into Vietnamese or registered as a separate name; all Vietnamese registration documents must be in Vietnamese.
prohibited_and_sensitive_tokens: Names identical or confusingly similar to previously registered enterprises in the national database
Words implying government institutions such as 'Bộ', 'Chính phủ', 'Ủy ban nhân dân', 'Công an', 'Quân đội', 'Hải quan', 'Thuế vụ'
Terms requiring ministerial approval: 'Ngân hàng', 'Chứng khoán', 'Bảo hiểm', 'Đầu tư quỹ', 'Y tế', 'Dược', 'Bất động sản', 'Du lịch', 'Khu công nghiệp', 'Khu chế xuất' (if not licensed)
Names that are contrary to historical and cultural norms or national security interests
Words containing symbols, signs, numbers, or punctuation marks as part of the proper name
The phrase 'Viet Nam' or 'VJP' unless used as part of a registered consolidated name with prior approval
statutory_name_clearance_protocol.extension_and_rejection_appeal_sop: The applicant may submit a re-registration request on the NBRP with a revised name. If the rejection is based on an allegedly erroneous comparison or an incorrect refusal of ministerial consent, the applicant may file a written appeal within 30 days from the refusal date to the Director of the Department of Planning and Investment (DPI) where the company is to be registered. If the DPI rejects the appeal, the applicant may file a complaint with the provincial People's Court or the Ministry of Planning and Investment (MPI) under the Law on Complaints (Law No. 02/2011/QH13). Extension of name reservation is not generally available; after the 30-day window, the name is released and the application must be refiled.

registered_office_and_commercial_substan.virtual_office_permissibility: Not permissible for a physical head office address. A Vietnamese registered entity must have a physical office address in Vietnam (lease agreement, ownership document, or free-of-charge use agreement). Virtual office or co-working mailbox-only addresses are accepted only if the provider maintains a physical office in the same locality and the lease agreement shows a dedicated floor/room allocated to the company, and the address can receive all official correspondence, accounting records storage, and tax inspection visits. For AI data labeling BPO operations, a physical office presence with staff is expected to meet data security and employment requirements.
registered_office_and_commercial_substan.physical_inspection_likelihood: 55% - 75% within the first year of operation, particularly triggered by foreign investment registration, labor-use registration, internal transfer pricing filings, or data security audits; unannounced site visits are common by tax authorities, labor inspectors, and public security (data security / cybersecurity) officers.

pre_incorporation_itemized_budget_usd.expense_line_item: Name reservation and enterprise registration application fee (offline or online via NBRP)
pre_incorporation_itemized_budget_usd.charging_authority: National Business Registration Portal / Department of Planning and Investment (DPI)
pre_incorporation_itemized_budget_usd.legal_fee_basis: Statutory tariff per Circular 47/2019/TT-BTC and Resolution 225/2020/NQ-UBTVQH14; no charge for online filing; one-time fee for offline filing of VND 100,000 (prox. USD 4)

pre_incorporation_itemized_budget_usd.expense_line_item: Foreign Investment Registration Certificate (IRC) application fee
pre_incorporation_itemized_budget_usd.charging_authority: Department of Planning and Investment (DPI) / Ministry of Planning and Investment (MPI)
pre_incorporation_itemized_budget_usd.legal_fee_basis: Statutory tariff under Circular 02/2021/TT-BTC; no prescribed fee for IRC issuance, but a notarized dossier preparation fee may apply

pre_incorporation_itemized_budget_usd.expense_line_item: Notarization of Vietnamese translation of corporate documents (statute, charter, resolutions)
pre_incorporation_itemized_budget_usd.charging_authority: Competent Notary Public Office (Phòng Công chứng) in Vietnam
pre_incorporation_itemized_budget_usd.legal_fee_basis: Notary fee schedule per Decree 23/2015/ND-CP and provincial notary fee regulations; market benchmark USD 30-80 per bundle

pre_incorporation_itemized_budget_usd.expense_line_item: Apostille / consular legalization of foreign corporate documents (certificate of incorporation, passport, power of attorney)
pre_incorporation_itemized_budget_usd.charging_authority: Ministry of Foreign Affairs (Apostille section) of the home country / Vietnamese Embassy/Consulate
pre_incorporation_itemized_budget_usd.legal_fee_basis: Hague Convention fee (varies by home country, typically USD 20-80 per document) + Vietnamese consular fee schedule; budget USD 100-150 per set

pre_incorporation_itemized_budget_usd.expense_line_item: Certified Vietnamese translation of apostilled/legalized documents by licensed translation company
pre_incorporation_itemized_budget_usd.legal_fee_basis: Market benchmark USD 0.15-0.30 per word; typical set of 150-250 pages costs USD 40-60

pre_incorporation_itemized_budget_usd.expense_line_item: Company seal (black ink, circular or rectangular stamp) fabrication and registration
pre_incorporation_itemized_budget_usd.charging_authority: Stamp maker licensed by the Ministry of Public Security; no separate national registration fee after enterprise registration (seal affixed in registry system)
pre_incorporation_itemized_budget_usd.legal_fee_basis: Market benchmark USD 10-25; statutory fee for publication in National Business Registration Portal if required

pre_incorporation_itemized_budget_usd.expense_line_item: Publication of enterprise registration content on National Business Registration Portal
pre_incorporation_itemized_budget_usd.legal_fee_basis: Standard fee per Circular 47/2019/TT-BTC; USD 10 (VND 200,000) for enterprise registration content publication

pre_incorporation_itemized_budget_usd.expense_line_item: Legal service fee for drafting the Company Charter, Investment Registration Application, and UBO declaration
pre_incorporation_itemized_budget_usd.legal_fee_basis: Prevailing market benchmark for standard LLC incorporation with foreign investment: USD 700-1,500; based on complexity of UBO structure

incorporation_legal_framework.governing_statute_and_sections: Law on Enterprises No. 59/2020/QH14 (Articles 20, 29, 38, 47, 50, 62, 64, and 122); Law on Investment No. 61/2020/QH14 (Articles 21, 22, 38, and 40); Decree No. 01/2021/ND-CP on enterprise registration; Decree No. 31/2021/ND-CP guiding the Law on Investment; Circular No. 02/2019/TT-BKHDT on electronic registration forms.
incorporation_legal_framework.competent_registry_authority: Department of Planning and Investment (DPI) of the Provincial People's Committee; for projects located in an industrial or export-processing zone, the Management Board of Industrial Zones (Ban Quản lý các khu công nghiệp); electronic filing performed through the National Business Registration Portal (https://dangkykinhdoanh.gov.vn) operated by the Agency for Business Registration under the Ministry of Planning and Investment.
incorporation_legal_framework.statutory_filing_instrument: For the foreign-investment stage: Application for Investment Registration (Giấy đề nghị đăng ký đầu tư) resulting in the Investment Registration Certificate (IRC) pursuant to Form A.I.2 of Decree 31/2021/ND-CP. For the enterprise stage: Application for Enterprise Registration (Giấy đề nghị đăng ký doanh nghiệp) resulting in the Enterprise Registration Certificate (ERC) pursuant to Form III-1 of Decree 01/2021/ND-CP.
incorporation_legal_framework.minimum_paid_up_capital_rule: No statutory minimum charter capital applies to an AI data-labeling BPO because the activity is not a conditional business and is not subject to the legal capital (vốn pháp định) regime; accordingly no escrow account or capital-blocking requirement is imposed. The charter capital is freely determined by the Members' Council and must be paid in full in VND or freely convertible foreign currency within 90 days from the date of issuance of the Enterprise Registration Certificate; a foreign-invested LLC must make capital contributions through a Direct Investment Capital Account (DICA) maintained at a licensed bank in Viet Nam, and the completed contribution must be reported to the DPI together with bank statements to update the business registration file.
incorporation_legal_framework.pro_forma_first_board_resolution_en: FIRST MEMBERS' COUNCIL RESOLUTION OF [COMPANY NAME] LIMITED LIABILITY COMPANY — Executed at [registered office] on [date] by the members holding 100% of the charter capital of VND [amount]. RESOLVED THAT: (1) The charter capital of VND [amount] is hereby subscribed and allocated to each member as set forth in the Company Charter and the capital contribution schedule; each member irrevocably undertakes to contribute the subscribed capital in full within 90 days from the date of issuance of the Enterprise Registration Certificate. (2) The Company Charter submitted for enterprise registration, together with all annexes, is adopted and ratified; the members approve the business scope covering AI data labeling, computer-vision bounding-box annotation, and RLHF data curation under ISIC 8220. (3) The registered office of the Company is established at [legal address], which is adopted as the Company's legal address under Article 20 of the Law on Enterprises No. 59/2020/QH14. (4) [Name] (passport/ID No. [number]) is elected Chairman of the Members' Council for a term of [term]; [Name] is appointed General Director with full authority to conduct the ordinary business operations of the Company. (5) [Name] is designated legal representative (Người đại diện theo pháp luật) of the Company with exclusive authority to sign the Enterprise Registration application, to appear before the Department of Planning and Investment, and to execute all post-registration filings. (6) The General Director is authorized and instructed to open a Direct Investment Capital Account and ordinary corporate account at [bank], to file the Enterprise Registration application with the competent DPI, and to publish the enterprise announcement on the National Business Registration Portal within 30 days after the ERC is issued. (7) The financial year commences on January 1 and ends on December 31 of each calendar year; the first financial year may run until December 31 following incorporation unless the ERC is issued in the fourth quarter, in which case the first financial year ends on December 31 of the next year. (8) The Chairman and the General Director are jointly and severally authorized to enter into all ancillary agreements necessary for the BPO business, including client data-processing agreements, cloud-hosting contracts, and cross-border disbursement service contracts lawfully procured for contractor payouts, provided that such services are used in compliance with the Law on Credit Institutions No. 47/2010/QH14, the State Bank of Viet Nam's foreign-exchange and anti-money-laundering regulations, and applicable sanctions-compliance statutes. PASSED by unanimous vote of the members representing 100% of the charter capital. [Signature], Chairman of the Members' Council; [Signature], Member.

step_by_step_formation_sop.step_name: Pre-Filing Eligibility Review and Corporate Name Availability Clearance
step_by_step_formation_sop.competent_authority: Department of Planning and Investment (DPI) — National Business Registration Portal name-search module (https://dangkykinhdoanh.gov.vn).
step_by_step_formation_sop.detailed_action_protocol: Conduct a pre-incorporation query on the National Business Registration Portal using the proposed bilingual corporate name, e.g., [Company Name] Co., Ltd. Together with a Vietnamese-language name; verify that the proposed name is not identical or confusingly similar to any registered enterprise, is not identical to the name of a state agency or armed-force unit, and otherwise complies with Articles 36 to 41 of Decree No. 01/2021/ND-CP. Confirm that ISIC 8220 (data labeling and AI-training BPO) is absent from the list of conditional business lines under Appendix IV of the Law on Investment No. 61/2020/QH14, meaning no prior sectoral license is required. Document the proposed charter capital, membership, and business-scope mapping for the subsequent filings.
required_dossiers: Proposed corporate name and two alternate names in Vietnamese and English
Draft business-scope statement mapped to ISIC 8220 and Vietnamese industry classification
Copies of passport or corporate formation documents of each intended foreign member
Memorandum confirming the non-conditional nature of the activity
step_by_step_formation_sop.adverse_action_remedies: If the name search returns a conflict or similarity warning, select the alternate name that adds at least one distinctive distinguishing element and re-run the portal query; final authority on name acceptability rests with the DPI at the time of ERC issuance, and any refusal at that stage is cured by filing an amended name application through the portal.

step_by_step_formation_sop.step_name: Notarization, Translation, and Consular Legalization of Constituent Documents
step_by_step_formation_sop.competent_authority: Provincial Notary Office (Phòng Công chứng) or private Notary Office (Văn phòng Công chứng) located in the province where the registered office is situated; consular legalization or apostille performed through the Ministry of Foreign Affairs for foreign-origin corporate documents.
step_by_step_formation_sop.detailed_action_protocol: Draft and execute the Company Charter (Điều lệ công ty) in the Vietnamese language containing the mandatory provisions of Article 24 of the Law on Enterprises, including the company name, registered office, charter capital, business lines, internal governance, legal representative, and capital-contribution schedule; have the charter, list of members, and passport copies notarized. For a foreign corporate member, obtain an apostille or consular legalization of its certificate of incorporation, certificate of good standing, and power of attorney, followed by a certified Vietnamese translation. Ensure the legal representative's signature authority is evidenced by a notarized power of attorney. Retain sufficient notarized copies for submission to the DPI.
required_dossiers: Notarized Company Charter in Vietnamese
List of members (Danh sách thành viên) with subscribed charter capital
Notarized passport or legal-entity verification of each member
Consular-legalized or apostilled power of attorney appointing the legal representative
Certified Vietnamese translation of all foreign-language documents
Capital contribution schedule signed by all members
step_by_step_formation_sop.adverse_action_remedies: If the notary raises a query on identity, signature authenticity, or translation accuracy, obtain fresh signature certification, re-legalize the foreign documents, and re-submit to the notary; any corrected page must be initialed and sealed by the notary before inclusion in the ERC dossier.

step_by_step_formation_sop.step_name: Investment Registration Certificate (IRC) Filing for the Foreign-Invested Project
step_by_step_formation_sop.competent_authority: Department of Planning and Investment (DPI) of the Provincial People's Committee, or the Management Board of Industrial/Export Processing Zones for projects within managed parks; electronic submission via the National Investment Registration System.
step_by_step_formation_sop.detailed_action_protocol: Prepare and file Form A.I.2 (Application for Investment Registration) for the foreign-invested LLC, describing the project title, investment objectives, expected scale and headcount, total investment capital, charter capital and mobilized operating capital, proposed location confirmed by a lease agreement or site-supporting documents, and the intended operating term. Because the project is a non-industrial service BPO office, no environmental preliminary appraisal or site-land clearance is triggered under Decree 31/2021/ND-CP. After verifying the dossier, the DPI issues the Investment Registration Certificate within 15 working days of receipt of a complete application; the IRC confirms the foreign-investment eligibility and enables the subsequent enterprise registration.
required_dossiers: Form A.I.2 signed by the authorized representative of the foreign investor
Notarized identity documents of the individual investors or legal-entity corporate extracts
Financial capacity evidence, such as bank statements or audited financial statements of the parent company
Location dossier comprising a signed office lease agreement or site-confirmation letter
Business plan covering the data-labeling services and estimated staffing of the ISIC 8220 operations
step_by_step_formation_sop.adverse_action_remedies: If the DPI issues a supplementary-document request, the applicant must cure within the requested period, normally not exceeding 30 days, by uploading the missing instruments to the investment-registration portal; if the application is formally rejected, the investor may file an administrative appeal to the Provincial People's Committee or withdraw and re-file a corrected application after resolving the stated grounds for refusal.

step_by_step_formation_sop.step_name: Enterprise Registration Certificate (ERC) Filing and Issuance
step_by_step_formation_sop.competent_authority: Department of Planning and Investment (DPI) — National Business Registration Portal.
step_by_step_formation_sop.detailed_action_protocol: Within 30 calendar days after receiving the IRC, file the online Application for Enterprise Registration (Form III-1) through the National Business Registration Portal. Attach the notarized Company Charter, the list of members, the IRC, and the identity documents of the legal representative. After examining the internal consistency of the dossier, the DPI issues the Enterprise Registration Certificate within 3 working days from receipt of a complete and valid application. The ERC contains the legal name, business lines, registered address, charter capital, legal representative, and the enterprise tax identification number automatically allocated by the General Department of Taxation; the tax registration is deemed completed upon issuance of the ERC.
required_dossiers: Form III-1 Application for Enterprise Registration
Notarized copy of the Company Charter
List of members with subscribed capital allocation
Notarized passport or ID copies of the foreign members
Original or certified copy of the Investment Registration Certificate (IRC)
Resolution or notarized power of attorney appointing the legal representative
step_by_step_formation_sop.adverse_action_remedies: If the DPI rejects the application or returns an online notice of deficiencies, the applicant must correct the indicated field-level errors and re-submit through the portal within the prescribed cure period; a lapsed or abandoned dossier requires a fresh application and a new fee payment; if the rejection relates to corporate-name confusion, the applicant should select a revised name and re-submit to the same DPI window.

step_by_step_formation_sop.step_name: Company Seal Procurement, Seal Notice, and Public Announcement of Establishment
step_by_step_formation_sop.competent_authority: Department of Planning and Investment for the public announcement and seal notice on the National Business Registration Portal; licensed seal-carving establishment supervised by the Provincial Police.
step_by_step_formation_sop.detailed_action_protocol: After issuance of the ERC, place an order with a licensed seal-carving establishment presenting the original ERC and the legal representative's ID; produce the corporate seal containing the company name and tax code. Publish the enterprise announcement of establishment on the National Business Registration Portal within 30 days from the ERC date, submitting the summary information in accordance with Article 43 of Decree 01/2021/ND-CP; optionally upload a high-resolution scan of the seal sample as a notice after the seal is first affixed to contracts or documents.
required_dossiers: Original Enterprise Registration Certificate
ID or passport of the legal representative and the seal recipient
Company seal sample scan (for portal notice)
Public announcement submission on the National Business Registration Portal
step_by_step_formation_sop.adverse_action_remedies: If the seal-carving establishment requests police verification of the ERC, allow an additional two working days for municipal police clearance; if the portal rejects the seal notice due to resolution or file quality, re-upload a sharper scan and re-submit; the public announcement can be amended through the portal's supplementary-notice function without repeating the ERC procedure.

step_by_step_formation_sop.step_name: Bank Account Opening, Direct Investment Capital Account (DICA), and Charter Capital Contribution
step_by_step_formation_sop.competent_authority: A licensed commercial bank in Viet Nam authorized to administer direct investment capital accounts; supervision by the State Bank of Viet Nam under the Foreign Exchange Ordinance No. 05/2005/PL-UBTVQH11 and Circular No. 06/2019/TT-NHNN.
step_by_step_formation_sop.detailed_action_protocol: Open the LLC's ordinary corporate transaction account and the Direct Investment Capital Account (DICA) at the licensed bank, presenting the ERC, IRC, company seal, and First Members' Council Resolution. Arrange inward remittance of the charter capital from abroad into the DICA no later than 90 days after the ERC issuance date; identify each capital remittance by the enterprise tax code and purpose code, and after each tranche obtain a bank credit note. Upon completion of the contribution, file the final declaration of capital contribution with the DPI together with the bank statements so that the business registration file reflects the fully paid charter capital; issue capital-contribution certificates to members in accordance with the Company Charter.
required_dossiers: Enterprise Registration Certificate and Investment Registration Certificate originals
Company seal and specimen of authorized signatories
First Members' Council Resolution appointing the signatories
Passport copies of the legal representative and members
Bank account application and beneficial-ownership declaration
Charter capital contribution schedule
step_by_step_formation_sop.adverse_action_remedies: If the bank queries the IRC or ERC data, obtain a reconciliation letter from the corporate registration office of the DPI and resubmit; if the statutory 90-day capital-contribution deadline is at risk, the members should execute an amended contribution schedule and file a supplementary notice with the DPI before the deadline; if the inward remittance is blocked by a sanctions or origin-of-funds query, the bank shall request a legal-ownership statement, and a substitute remittance path via a permitted correspondent bank may be used after consultation with the State Bank's Foreign Exchange Division.

step_by_step_formation_sop.step_name: Post-Incorporation Activation: Tax File, Electronic Invoices, Labor Registration, Social Insurance, and Cross-Border Payment Compliance
step_by_step_formation_sop.competent_authority: Provincial Tax Department via the General Department of Taxation's Electronic Tax Portal; Provincial Department of Labor, Invalids and Social Affairs (DoLISA); provincial Social Insurance Agency (Bảo hiểm xã hội); Fire Prevention and Rescue Police for premises acceptance.
step_by_step_formation_sop.detailed_action_protocol: Activate the enterprise tax file using the tax code printed on the ERC; register for electronic invoicing with the Tax Department through the e-invoice module using Form Mẫu 01/ĐKTĐ, after which the LLC may issue e-invoices for its BPO services. Execute labor contracts with staff, register labor use with DoLISA within 10 days of the first hire, and submit the monthly social, health, and unemployment insurance declarations to the provincial Social Insurance Agency. Before accepting cross-border client contracts, ensure that the invoicing and payment flows comply with Circular 06/2019/TT-NHNN; any payable rails such as Mass_PayPal_Payout or Wise must be contracted through a licensed payment-service provider and settled into the LLC's domestic bank account, never into a foreign personal account. Complete the fire-safety acceptance inspection for the premises in accordance with the physical licensing block below before commencing operations.
required_dossiers: Enterprise Registration Certificate containing the tax identification number
Lease agreement and certificate of legal use of the office premises
List of employees and signed labor contracts
Electronic-invoice registration form (Mẫu 01/ĐKTĐ)
Fire-safety acceptance minutes (Văn bản nghiệm thu về phòng cháy và chữa cháy)
Bank account certificates for the ordinary account and DICA
step_by_step_formation_sop.adverse_action_remedies: If the tax file is not auto-unlocked, contact the direct tax-management division with the ERC and IRC originals and request manual activation; if DoLISA rejects the labor-use registration, supplement missing labor contracts and ID copies and re-file; if the schedule of the fire-safety inspection is delayed, submit a written self-certification of internal fire-safety arrangements and schedule a re-inspection; for payment-rail refusals by banks, obtain a legal opinion and shift cross-border settlements to a licensed commercial bank's trade-payment channel.

national_tax_registration_infrastructure.competent_tax_authority: General Department of Taxation (GDT, Tổng cục Thuế) under the Ministry of Finance (Bộ Tài chính); electronic administration via the National E-Tax Portal (https://etaxvn.gdt.gov.vn) and the GDT E-Invoice Portal (https://hoadondientu.gdt.gov.vn). Provincial-level administration is delegated to local Tax Departments (Cục Thuế) such as Hanoi and Ho Chi Minh City.
national_tax_registration_infrastructure.tax_id_procurement_sop: A foreign-invested LLC automatically obtains a single statutory Tax Identification Number (MST, Mã số thuế) upon issuance of the Enterprise Registration Certificate by the local Business Registration Office (Sở Kế hoạch và Đầu tư) through the National Enterprise Registration Portal (https://dangkykinhdoanh.gov.vn). The MST serves as the unified CIT, VAT, payroll, and customs identifier. Post-incorporation steps: (1) update full supplementary tax registration with Form 01-ĐK-TCT on the e-tax portal; (2) declare the VAT filing method and accounting regime; (3) obtain and register a digital signature (Token/CA) and a licensed e-invoice solution under Decree 123/2020/ND-CP; (4) open a licensed commercial-bank current account (both VND and foreign currency) and inform the GDT; (5) complete any CIT/VAT incentive registration if locating in a high-tech, IT park, or export-processing zone.
national_tax_registration_infrastructure.default_entity_tax_classification: Entity_Level_Taxation - the VN_LLC is a Vietnamese tax-resident enterprise subject to enterprise income tax (CIT) on worldwide income at the standard headline rate of 20% under Law No. 14/2008/QH12 (as amended by Laws No. 32/2013/QH13 and No. 71/2014/QH13). There is no partnership pass-through or disregarded-entity regime recognized; profits are taxed at the LLC level, and outbound distributions/payments to offshore owners will bear separate dividend/interest/royalty WHT. The 'software products and digital data services' characterization of ISIC 8220 data-labeling activities may, if properly certified in a qualifying IT/high-tech or EPE zone, support a 10% CIT rate, a 4-year CIT exemption, and a 9-year 50% reduction under current incentive law, but requires pre-approval by the competent investment authority.
national_tax_registration_infrastructure.statutory_election_mechanisms: Viet Nam does not operate a US-style 'check-the-box' system; the LLC is mandatorily taxed at entity level with no hybrid-entity election. Statutory elections and structured choices include: (1) election to carry forward CIT losses against future taxable profits for a maximum of 5 years; (2) election of Foreign Tax Credit crediting rules under Circular 08/2019/TT-BTC for foreign-sourced AI-training revenue; (3) election to apply 0% export VAT on qualifying offshore service contracts under Circular 219/2013/TT-BTC; (4) transfer-pricing method election (most favored: transactional net margin method) and advance pricing agreement application under Decree 132/2020/ND-CP; (5) election for global minimum top-up tax compliance under Resolution 107/2023/QH15 if the consolidated MNE group exceeds EUR 750 million revenue; (6) on a transactional basis, election of the deemed DNT/foreign-contractor regime where services are resold into Viet Nam by an offshore principal.

indirect_taxation_nexus_and_rules.indirect_tax_system_name: VAT (Thuế Giá trị gia tăng / Value Added Tax) - a broad-based destination-principle VAT applied to supplies of goods and services under VAT Law No. 13/2008/QH12 (as amended by Laws No. 31/2013/QH13 and No. 106/2016/QH13); services exported and consumed offshore are zero-rated.
indirect_taxation_nexus_and_rules.statutory_registration_threshold_local_c: No economic turnover threshold applies to the VN_LLC; a foreign-invested enterprise is mandatorily VAT-registered from the moment of enterprise registration regardless of pre-revenue status. A VND 100,000,000 (one hundred million dong, approx. USD 4,000) annual revenue threshold applies only to household business establishments and individuals under Decree 209/2013/ND-CP, not to LLCs. Data-labeling BPO services exported to foreign clients are not subject to any domestic registration threshold beyond the enterprise's compulsory VAT identity.
indirect_taxation_nexus_and_rules.electronic_invoicing_and_clearance_manda: Electronic invoicing with mandatory transmission to the GDT has been obligatory for all VAT taxpayers, including the VN_LLC, since 1 July 2022 under Decree 123/2020/ND-CP and Circular 78/2021/TT-BTC. Each e-invoice must be issued in XML format, bear a QR code, a seller digital signature, and be transmitted to the GDT e-invoice portal immediately at the point of issuance (near-real-time RTIR-style clearance). Taxpayers classified as high compliance risk, or those identified for fiscal control, must use a GDT 'coded invoice' (hóa đơn điện tử có mã của cơ quan thuế) in which the tax authority assigns a validation code before the invoice becomes legally effective. There is no physical stamping or paper seal regime; the GDT coded/QR invoice data serves as the fiscal clearance marker. Failure to transmit invoice data in the mandatory format with valid certificate or failure to include the 0% export VAT indicator will make the invoice legally ineffective and may trigger penalty under Decree 125/2020/ND-CP.
indirect_taxation_nexus_and_rules.digital_stamping_note: Applied GDT 'coded e-invoice' mechanism requiring tax-authority pre-clearance and issuance of a unique code for at-risk taxpayers; compliant exporters use the non-coded e-invoice stream with API-based real-time transmission.

export_zero_rating_and_refund_substantia.zero_rating_eligibility: AI data-labeling, bounding-box annotation, and RLHF data-curation BPO services qualify for the 0% VAT export rate under Circular 219/2013/TT-BTC only when all conditions are cumulatively satisfied: (1) the service is provided under a written contract to a foreign organization or individual without a Vietnamese permanent establishment; (2) the service is consumed outside Viet Nam, evidenced by contract terms, data-flow infrastructure, and the absence of domestic end-users; (3) the VN_LLC performs the service inputs in Viet Nam but delivers/transfers the benefit to the offshore party; (4) consideration is paid in foreign currency through licensed Vietnamese banks via inward remittance; (5) an e-invoice is issued at 0% VAT showing the correct export service wording and GDT transmission code. Services provided to Vietnamese-onshore counterparties, services physically delivered in Viet Nam, and services embedded in a domestic value chain cannot use 0% and are taxable at the 8-10% standard/reduced rate.
mandatory_customs_documentation_bundle: Customs Export Declaration (Tờ khai hải quan xuất khẩu) - mandatory only where physical storage media, embedded servers, or hardware prototypes are shipped abroad in support of the data-labeling service
Bill of Lading or Air Waybill (Vận đơn đường biển/đường hàng không) - evidencing cross-border movement of physical media, if any

Inward Remittance Certificate (Chứng từ thanh toán qua ngân hàng có xác nhận của ngân hàng) issued by a Vietnamese licensed bank, evidencing receipt of export service proceeds in foreign currency remitted from the foreign client
Export Service Contract (Hợp đồng dịch vụ xuất khẩu) clearly defining delivery scope, acceptance criteria, offshore consumption, intellectual-property treatment, and payment terms
Service Completion and Acceptance Report (Biên bản nghiệm thu hoàn thành công việc) signed by the offshore counterparty or platform evidencing delivery of annotation/RLHF data outputs
Zero-rated VAT e-invoice (Hóa đơn điện tử thuế suất 0%) bearing the GDT invoice code and QR stamp, with proof of immediate transmission to the tax authority
Internal substance and cost file evidencing actual AI-training data processing capacity, headcount, and delivery infrastructure in Viet Nam for transfer-pricing and economic-substance verification
export_zero_rating_and_refund_substantia.audit_scrutiny_and_clawback_penalties: The GDT may conduct tax audits and VAT-refund post-clearance reviews within the 5-year statute of limitations under Law No. 38/2019/QH14. If export zero-rating or VAT refund claims are disallowed due to missing inward remittance proof, absence of foreign-consumption evidence, presence of a Vietnamese PE, circular/false documentation, or non-compliant e-invoice data transmission, the consequences are cumulative: (1) clawback of the entire VAT refund plus reassessment at the standard 10% rate on the gross invoiced amount; (2) administrative penalty equal to 20% of the under-declared or fraudulently refunded tax under Article 17 of Decree 125/2020/ND-CP, capped only by the actual unlawful benefit and augmented by late-payment interest at 0.03% per day (approx. 10.95% per annum); (3) invalidation of zero-rated invoices resulting in cascade liability across all affected tax periods; (4) economic-substance and transfer-pricing recharacterization under Decree 132/2020/ND-CP, including a deemed profit uplift for the BPO activity, which may eliminate any claimed refund or incentive; (5) where the fraudulent evasion or refund-claim abuse causes state revenue loss of more than VND 100 million, criminal prosecution under Article 200 of the Penal Code 2015 is available, with corporate and individual penalties ranging from monetary fines (up to VND 4.5 billion) to suspended imprisonment and compulsory restitution. Exporters must therefore retain the complete 'export file' for a minimum of 10 years and ensure all FX receipts repatriated within the mandatory 180-day window and reflected in both bank records and tax returns.

fx_control_regime_and_central_bank_regul.central_bank_authority: State Bank of Vietnam (Ngân hàng Nhà nước Việt Nam)
fx_control_regime_and_central_bank_regul.currency_convertibility_assessment: Vietnam maintains a current-account-convertible but capital-account-controlled foreign exchange regime under the Ordinance on Foreign Exchange (No. 05/2017/PL-UBTVQH14) and implementing circulars, principally Circular No. 02/2021/TT-NHNN. Legal current-account payments, including cross-border service fees, staff salaries for expatriates, and profit remittances to foreign investors, are freely executable through licensed banks upon presentation of supporting documentation. However, VND is not fully convertible offshore; all conversion must take place through the onshore interbank market via a licensed commercial bank. Profit remittance is conditioned on completion of annual audited financial statements, tax finalization, and the use of a registered Foreign Direct Investment (FDI) capital account (Direct Investment Capital Account - DICA). Remittance may be made once annually or in stages, with advance remittance requiring an auditor's confirmation of distributable profits. Capital-account flows remain controlled: foreign borrowing must be registered with the SBV unless exempt, equity injections must enter through the DICA, and VND lending to foreign-invested enterprises is subject to net-debt/equity ratio and risk-limitation regulations.
fx_control_regime_and_central_bank_regul.export_proceeds_surrender_rules: Under Decree No. 70/2016/ND-CP and Circular No. 02/2021/TT-NHNN, export proceeds from services must be collected through licensed banks and repatriated into the exporter's foreign-currency account within 180 days from the date of the invoice or the export customs clearance date, whichever is applicable, unless an extension is granted by the SBV for force majeure or documented international payment delays. There is no mandatory conversion ratio currently applicable; the obligation is satisfied whether the proceeds are retained in a foreign-currency account at a licensed bank or sold into VND. For AI data-labeling and BPO cross-border service contracts, each invoice should contain the contract reference, delivery milestone evidence, and the bank's electronic SWIFT credit confirmation to support the 180-day repatriation narrative. Failure to repatriate on time triggers SBV inspection, fines, and restrictions on subsequent foreign-currency account usage.

corporate_banking_onboarding_blueprint.fintech_emi_cross_border_viability: Digital EMIs and payment platforms such as Wise, PayPal Business, and multi-currency neobank accounts are viable for low-value recurring disbursements and international client aggregations, but they cannot legally replace a supervisory bank in Vietnam. Feasibility rating: High for daily operational micro-payments (under approximately USD 10,000) and for receiving high-volume small-labeling invoices through Wise/PayPal; Medium when used as a supplementary collection rail; Low as the sole treasury backbone. Legal constraints: Offshore EMIs are not licensed by the State Bank of Vietnam to hold VND balances or provide local payment accounts; any payment service that establishes accounts for Vietnamese residents requires a SBV license. Cross-border payments initiated by EMI platforms must ultimately be converted and repatriated through a licensed Vietnamese bank to comply with export-proceeds surrender rules. Concentrated use of EMIs for invoicing does not satisfy statutory DICA or VAT invoicing requirements, and the LLC should maintain a local VND account for all VAT-paid local disbursements and salary payments.
corporate_banking_onboarding_blueprint.physical_presence_and_kyc_interview_mand: The statutory KYC regime under SBV AML/CFT regulations (Decree No. 230/2022/ND-CP) and the Credit Institution Law mandates full customer due diligence prior to account opening. In practice, all major Vietnamese banks require an in-person interview with the legal representative, the 75% or more beneficial owner, or a fully authorized local officer at the branch where the account is opened. Remote video verification is permitted only as a supplementary step after the physical identification of a resident officer or attorney-in-fact; a foreign-owned LLC cannot open accounts purely through online channels. Mandatory documentation includes the board resolution authorizing account opening, a certified list of specimen signatories, the Enterprise Registration Certificate (ERC), the Investment Registration Certificate (IRC), passport copies with consular legalization or notarization, and evidence of physical office presence in Vietnam. This mandate applies equally to the DICA capital account and to the operational VND/FX account.

critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.trigger_point: Fully foreign-owned LLC with multi-layer offshore shareholders and opaque UBO structure
critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.evidentiary_defense_dossier: Notarized certificate of incorporation of each parent entity, a clean ownership chart showing all natural persons holding >10% interests, a signed beneficial ownership declaration under Decree 230/2022/ND-CP, audited financial statements or asset proof for the ultimate holding entity, corporate standing certificates, and a letter of comfort confirming the source of funds for the initial capital contribution.

critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.trigger_point: Cross-border AI data-labeling and BPO contracts with no clear invoice trail or delivery evidence
critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.evidentiary_defense_dossier: Master service agreements with each client, detailed statements of work for CVM bounding-box annotation and RLHF data curation, monthly invoices with unique invoice numbers, project delivery tickets, uploaded annotation output logs, and a reconciliation report connecting each SWIFT/MT103 payment to the corresponding deliverable.

critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.trigger_point: Clients or payors linked to high-risk jurisdictions, sanctions-listed entities, or exposed persons
critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.evidentiary_defense_dossier: Completed client risk-rating questionnaires, sanctions screening certificates from an internationally recognized compliance database, PEP screening results, a written economic-sanctions compliance policy, board resolution identifying permissible countries/clients, and signed contractual warranty clauses prohibiting involvement with sanctioned parties.

critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.trigger_point: Perceived lack of commercial substance or shell-LIC risk
critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.evidentiary_defense_dossier: Vietnam-hosted office lease agreement registered with local authorities, payroll records for Vietnamese employees and PIT declarations, social insurance contribution logs, annual enterprise income tax and VAT filings, utility bills, and photographs or a video tour of the in-country operating facility.

cross_border_liquidity_and_clearing_rail.inbound_capital_injection_routing: Compliant FDI equity injection flows: (1) Execute the equity contribution within the registered capital authority evidenced by the IRC; (2) open the Direct Investment Capital Account (DICA) at a licensed tiers-1 bank using the IRC, ERC, and board resolution; (3) instruct the overseas corporate bank to send a SWIFT MT103 screened under the beneficiary DICA account name and number, quoting the investment-capital contribution purpose and the IRC number in the narrative; (4) after receiving the funds, present the SWIFT import advice to the treasury desk for issuance of the bank's official foreign-exchange trading record / payment confirmation; (5) classify the payment under the SBV balance-of-payments reporting code corresponding to 'direct investment equity capital contribution' (a sub-item under BPM6 financial account, code 3620 or the equivalent as defined by the reporting bank); (6) do not intermingle equity proceeds with service revenue in the DICA; operational revenue must flow into the separate operational VND/FX account. For shareholder loans, register the loan agreement with the SBV before inbound remittance, using the cross-border loan reporting code and a separate SWIFT narrative.
cross_border_liquidity_and_clearing_rail.outbound_trade_disbursements: For service-company treasury, outbound disbursements are split between international contractor settlements and domestic VND obligations. International contractor/platform payments should use SWIFT MT103 from the operational USD account, with the invoice reference and contract number in forwarding instructions; commercial letters of credit (LC) are rarely used for AI services but may apply to physical hardware acquisitions, in which case the issuing bank will establish an MT700 LC against a sales contract and logistics documents. For domestic payroll and supplier payments, use the VND clearing system (NAPAS ACH or the bank's internal transfer network) initiated from the operational VND account. When the company receives USD from clients and needs VND locally, execute a deliverable FX spot transaction or forward with the treasury bank and record the corresponding foreign-exchange trade. All outgoing wires must carry the underlying service contract details, be issued only to contractually recognized payees, and be reconciled with the monthly tax/VAT invoices to satisfy inspection requirements.
permissible_fx_hedging_instruments: Onshore Deliverable FX Forward (maturity up to 365 days) against a documented trade or investment cash flow
Onshore FX Swap (same-maturity or staggered legs) using VND/USD for working capital bridging
Onshore European-style FX Option purchased from an SBV-licensed credit institution
Cross-currency interest-rate swap with a licensed bank for longer-term foreign-currency balance sheet hedging

annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.receiving_authority: Provincial Department of Planning and Investment (DPI) via the National Business Registration Portal
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.statutory_deadline_window: Within 90 days from fiscal year-end; by 31 March for calendar-year financial statement entities
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.delinquency_sanctions: Administrative fine under Decree 50/2016 as amended and placement on the non-compliant enterprise list; failure to submit for more than 6 months after the statutory deadline can trigger administrative dissolution or revocation of enterprise registration.

annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.receiving_authority: Managing sub-department of taxation via the national eTax portal
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.statutory_deadline_window: Due annually by 30 January; newly established enterprises are exempt in the first operating year
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.delinquency_sanctions: Late-payment interest of 0.03% per day and administrative penalties under tax law; continued non-payment permits tax debt enforcement and suspension of electronic invoicing until payment is cleared.

annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.statutory_deliverable: Annual Corporate Income Tax finalization return
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.receiving_authority: General Department of Taxation / managing tax office through eTax
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.statutory_deadline_window: By the 30th day of the third month after fiscal year-end; 31 March for calendar-year taxpayers
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.delinquency_sanctions: Late-filing penalties of up to VND 20,000,000; late-payment interest of 0.03% per day; under-declared CIT penalty up to 20%; persistent non-compliance may lead to invoice suspension and enhanced tax inspection.

annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.statutory_deliverable: Annual audited financial statements and foreign-invested enterprise annual investment report
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.receiving_authority: Tax authority and Provincial DPI under FDI reporting requirements
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.statutory_deadline_window: Within 90 days after fiscal year-end; by 31 March for calendar-year entities and before filing the CIT finalization return
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.delinquency_sanctions: Failure to submit audited financial statements is an administrative violation and prevents verified tax finalization; repeated non-compliance increases tax-inspection risk and can result in enforcement measures under tax administration law.

statutory_audit_and_accounting_mandate.compulsory_audit_thresholds: All foreign-invested enterprises, including a wholly foreign-owned data-labeling BPO LLC, must appoint a licensed independent audit firm annually; there is no revenue, asset, or employee-size exemption for FDI entities.
statutory_audit_and_accounting_mandate.governing_accounting_framework: Vietnamese Accounting Standards (VAS) and Circular 200/2014/TT-BTC; IFRS may be used separately for the foreign parent's consolidated reporting but cannot replace the statutory VAS annual financial statements.

corporate_registers_and_ubo_annual_confi.ubo_annual_confirmation_protocol: Vietnam does not require a free-standing annual UBO confirmation to the business registry for a private LLC. The company must maintain an up-to-date member register and report any ownership transfer to the DPI within 10 days; AML/KYC records containing beneficial-owner information must be updated and retained for at least 5 years after the business relationship ends.

recurring_annual_maintenance_budget_usd.registered_office_or_agent_market_range_: US$500–US$2,000 per year for registered-office and corporate-compliance agent services in Hanoi or Ho Chi Minh City
recurring_annual_maintenance_budget_usd.statutory_audit_estimated_fee_usd: US$1,000–US$3,000 per year for a small-to-mid-market AI data-labeling LLC

corporate_income_tax_regime.effective_tax_rate_incentives: No automatic CIT holiday exists solely for ISIC 8220 data-labeling and AI-BPO services. A foreign-invested LLC is taxable at 20% unless it obtains certificate-based incentives. Eligible high-tech enterprises or projects in hi-tech/economic zones may qualify for a 10% preferential rate for up to 15 years, a 4-year CIT exemption and a 9-year 50% reduction, or a 2-year exemption and 4-year 50% reduction in difficult-area zones. Software-production enterprises and qualified R&D activities may also access preferential deductions, but a data-labeling service provider must demonstrate that it is operating within the statutory definition of an incentivized activity, not merely using software as an input.
